subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The prescribed minimal fix has NOT been implemented. The provider still uses `useMemo(() => ({ content: defaultContent }), [defaultContent])` which freezes content at initialization time. The branch AI-AMSD-2041 is identical to develop (same commit 43d6cca6) — there are zero changes for this story. The prescribed fix requires replacing useMemo with useState(defaultContent) and adding a useEffect that subscribes to Stack.livePreview.onContentUpdate to call setContent. Without this, no live preview edits can propagate to any of the 236+ consuming components, and ALL acceptance criteria are unmet.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the useMemo with: `const [content, setContent] = useState(defaultContent);` and add: `useEffect(() => { Stack.livePreview.onContentUpdate((updatedContent) => setContent(prev => ({ ...prev, ...updatedContent }))); }, []);` Then change the Provider value to `{ content }` from state. Import useState, useEffect from react and Stack from the Contentstack live-preview-utils SDK.

issues.description: No livePreview callback registration exists anywhere in the codebase. Even if useState were added, without registering the Contentstack SDK's onContentUpdate callback, setContent is never invoked and the context never updates. Grep for livePreview/live_preview across the project returns zero results.
issues.suggestedFix: Register the Stack.livePreview.onContentUpdate callback in the useEffect as described in the prescribed fix, ensuring the SDK is initialized at app bootstrap (e.g., _app.tsx).

issues.description: No includeDraft flag is propagated through the public-facing contentstack service functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getSingletonEntry). Without this, draft content will never be served even if the provider is fixed. The preview flag from getStaticProps context must reach the ContentstackFactory query layer.
issues.suggestedFix: Add includeDraft to IContentstackGetEntry, IContentstackGetSingleEntry, IContentstackGetSingletonEntry interfaces, propagate it through the public functions to ContentstackFactory, and have pages pass context.preview through as includeDraft: true.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests were added for the live preview / includeDraft functionality. Per review criteria, new features must have corresponding vitest unit tests in test/unit/ mirroring the src/ path. There are zero tests verifying that setContent updates the context value, that the initial state matches defaultContent, or that includeDraft: true causes addParam('include_draft', 'true').
issues.suggestedFix: Add test files mirroring src/context/ContentstackContext.tsx and the contentstack service layer, verifying: (1) initial content state equals defaultContent, (2) onContentUpdate callback triggers setContent and updates context value, (3) includeDraft: true propagates include_draft param to the factory.
